action.name: User Profile
action.description: Show project identity controls, the reusable LOOM account/global profile, privilege, network metadata, analytics, and history.

user_actions.name: Save Username
user_actions.description: Persist a display username against this LOOM client identity.

user_actions.name: Refresh Profile Analytics
user_actions.description: Refresh lifetime usage and session analytics.

user_actions.name: Create Permanent Account
user_actions.description: Attach email/password login to a named LOOM identity.

user_actions.name: Sign In
user_actions.description: Sign in to a permanent LOOM account.

user_actions.name: Sign Out
user_actions.description: End the current permanent account login.

user_actions.name: Upload Profile Picture
user_actions.description: Compress and persist a custom LOOM profile picture.

user_actions.name: Use LOOM Default Avatar
user_actions.description: Switch the profile picture back to the native LOOM default.

user_actions.name: Use Project Default Avatar
user_actions.description: Use the active project avatar provider default when available.

user_actions.name: Create Project Avatar
user_actions.description: Create an avatar through a project-provided avatar creator.

user_actions.name: Use LOOM Profile Picture
user_actions.description: Make this project inherit the LOOM-wide profile picture.

user_actions.name: Copy Project Picture to LOOM Profile
user_actions.description: Retrieve an existing project profile picture and use it as the global LOOM profile picture.

permissions.story: Change my own LOOM profile and avatar.
